comparison.objective: Return a hive frame onto two rests and slide it against neighboring frames; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-object lifting, dual-lug seating, leveling and lateral close packing versus hex-key use, fine adjustment, relocking and cyclic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Body requires both lugs supported, ≤2° level, ≤3° square, ≤5 mm centering and ≤2 mm neighbor gap; no complete spec version is present. Candidate uses dynamic stop and lock-drift thresholds.
comparison.reason: The hive task is constrained insertion and seating, not adjustable mechanism calibration.
